facts.value: Support in answering questions such as 'What do I want?' - 'What can I do?' - 'Where do I want to go?' is provided by the Employment Agency.
Goethe University offers career coaching to help students develop their individual profile and professional direction.
The Career Service at Goethe University provides honest feedback on the first impression of application materials.
Staff from Goethe University, the Employment Agency, and Campus Services check application documents for completeness, clarity, and organization.
Support is provided in optimizing the phrasing and structure of applications.

Questions answered include how to write an attractive cover letter, align a job advertisement with application documents, present individual competencies, discuss work experiences, and whether to include interests in a CV.
Open consultation hours and appointment booking are available for application document checks.
International students seeking support for the application process can turn to the International Career Service at Goethe University.
A consultation calendar is available for students to overview all advisory offerings of the Career Service at Goethe University, with direct appointment booking.
Students with doubts about their studies can receive support from the Frankfurt Counseling Network, which includes Goethe University.
